sessionKey: 密钥仅在本次服务中有效，重启后需重新填写。
The key lasts for this service session. Enter it again after restarting.
environmentKey: 密钥来自服务环境变量。
The key comes from the service environment.
coreDescription: 离线生成、约束处理与数据库写入
Offline generation, constraints and database writes
cliDescription: 在终端配置、预览和生成数据
Configure, preview and generate data in a terminal
aiDescription: 根据表结构与业务说明提出规则建议
Suggest rules from table structure and business requirements
mcpDescription: 供 MCP 客户端调用生成能力
Expose generation capabilities to MCP clients
baseDescription: 内置基础数据与语义占位值
Built-in basic data and semantic placeholders
fakerDescription: 姓名、地址等本地化测试数据
Localized test data such as names and addresses
mimesisDescription: 另一种本地化数据实现，可按场景选择
modelPlaceholder: 填写服务提供的完整模型 ID
Enter the full model ID provided by the service
reverted: 已恢复当前生效的设置。
probeHint: 检测连接可读取服务中的模型列表；不会自动开始分析。
Testing the connection reads the model list; it does not start analysis.
disableSessionKey: Disable the key for this service session
aiSubtitle: 配置默认服务，供工作台的 AI 配置助手使用。
Configure the default service for the Workbench AI configuration assistant.
currentAI: 当前使用的 AI 服务
pluginsSubtitle: 查看当前 Web 服务所在 Python 环境中的组件。
View components in the Python environment running this Web service.
generationSubtitle: 设置新配置的常用起点；已有配置保持原值。
Choose starting values for new configurations. Existing configurations keep their values.
appearanceSubtitle: 选择适合当前环境的界面明暗。
Choose a light or dark appearance for your environment.
appearanceHint: 立即生效，仅保存在当前浏览器。不改变 AI 服务设置或生成配置；跟随系统会自动响应系统的明暗变化。
Applies immediately and is saved in this browser. AI settings and generation configurations stay unchanged. System mode follows your system appearance.
unsavedReturn: AI 服务设置尚未保存。可以继续编辑并保存，或放弃修改后返回。
AI service settings are not saved. Continue editing and save, or discard changes and return.
title: 设置
Settings
subtitle: 管理新建配置偏好、界面外观、AI 服务和扩展能力。
Manage new configuration defaults, appearance, AI services and optional components.
maintenanceAI: 维护模式仅提供插件管理，重启普通模式后可配置 AI。
Maintenance mode only provides plugin management. Restart in normal mode to configure AI.
maintenanceAppearance: 维护模式仅提供插件管理，恢复服务后可调整外观。
Maintenance mode only provides plugin management. Restore the service to change appearance.
expiredContext: 原来的分析上下文已失效，请从工作台重新打开 AI 助手。
The previous analysis context has expired. Reopen the AI assistant from the Workbench.
retest: 设置已变化，请重新检测。
Settings have changed. Test the connection again.
unsaved: 有未保存的修改；检测连接不会保存。
There are unsaved changes. Testing the connection does not save them.
noChanges: 没有待保存的更改。可直接检测连接。
There are no changes to save. You can test the connection.
alreadySaved: 当前表单与生效设置一致，无需重复保存
The form matches the active settings; no need to save again
ollamaHint: Ollama 可连接本地或云端模型；本机服务地址不代表模型一定在本机运行。
Ollama can connect to local or cloud models. A local service URL does not guarantee that the model runs locally.
lmStudioHint: 填写 LM Studio 服务地址，并在服务中加载需要使用的模型。
Enter the LM Studio service URL and load the model you want to use in the service.
compatibleHint: 使用提供方公布的 API 地址和模型 ID。OpenAI 兼容服务地址通常以 /v1 结尾。
Use the provider’s API URL and model ID. OpenAI-compatible URLs usually end in /v1.
serviceKey: API key (if required by the service)
keepKey: 留空保留同一服务的已配置密钥
Leave blank to keep the existing key for this service
authKey: 服务启用了认证时填写
Enter if the service requires authentication
localAuthHint: 默认本地服务无需密钥，修改地址或模型后即可保存；启用认证时按服务要求填写。
Local services usually need no key. Save after changing the URL or model; enter a key if authentication is enabled.
remoteAuthHint: 按提供方要求配置认证；不同服务之间不会沿用已配置的密钥。
Configure authentication as required by your provider. Keys are not reused across different services.
savedAI: 已保存的 AI 服务
readinessHint: 配置状态与服务连通性分别检查。
Configuration readiness and service connectivity are checked separately.
sharedSettings: 服务类型、地址和模型保存在运行 Web 的设备上，重启后仍保留。同一 Web 服务的浏览器共享这些设置；修改后用于下一次分析。
The service type, URL and model are saved on the device running Web and persist after restart. Browsers using this service share these settings; changes apply to the next analysis.
keyStorage: 界面填写的密钥仅在本次服务中有效；如需重启后继续使用，可在启动环境中配置。密钥不写入生成配置或运行记录。
Keys entered here last for this service session. Configure them in the launch environment to retain them after restart. Keys are never stored in generation configurations or run records.
settingsPath: 当前 Web 服务的配置文件位置
Configuration file for the current Web service
settingsPathHint: 按启动 Web 的用户和操作系统自动选择；也可通过 SQLSEED_WEB_SETTINGS_PATH 指定。远程访问时，这里是服务器上的位置。
Selected by the operating system and the user running Web; override with SQLSEED_WEB_SETTINGS_PATH. For remote access, this is a path on the server.
aiDependencyHint: AI 插件已安装，但加载失败，请检查运行 Web 的环境依赖。
The AI plugin is installed but could not load. Check the dependencies of the environment running Web.
saved: 设置已保存，下一次 AI 分析将使用此配置。
Settings saved. The next AI analysis will use this configuration.
connectionRefreshFailed: 组件状态已刷新；当前数据库连接信息暂时无法更新。
Component status refreshed, but the current database connection information could not be updated.
maintenanceVersions: 版本来自当前安装环境；维护模式不加载组件。安装或卸载后需重启普通模式，再验证组件可用性。
Versions come from the installed environment. Components are not loaded in maintenance mode. Restart in normal mode after installation or removal to verify availability.
installedVersions: 版本来自当前安装环境，不表示最新发布版本。“可用”表示组件可加载；AI 服务需单独检测。生成引擎在工作台选择，可选扩展按需安装。

Versions describe the installed environment, not the latest releases. Available means a component can load; test AI connectivity separately. Choose a generation engine in the Workbench and install extensions as needed.
noInstallCommand: 未提供可直接执行的命令。请使用创建此 Python 环境的工具安装或修复组件。
No executable command is available. Use the tool that created this Python environment to install or repair components.
copyUnavailable: 当前浏览器无法自动复制，请手动选择并复制上方命令。
Automatic copying is unavailable in this browser. Select and copy the command above.
copyFailed: 复制失败，请手动选择并复制上方命令。
Copy failed. Select and copy the command above.
checkEnvironment: 请在运行 Web 的 Python 环境中检查此组件。
Check this component in the Python environment running Web.
probeSuccess: 服务连接成功，仅验证模型列表。
Connected to the service. Only the model list was verified.
retainedSettings: {impact} 已保存的服务设置会保留。
loadError: 无法读取 AI 设置：{detail}
environmentSummary: {implementation} {version} · 当前 Web 服务环境
terminalInstructions: 在运行 Web 的设备终端{shell}操作，完成后重启 Web 并刷新状态。
Run in the terminal{shell} on the device hosting Web, then restart Web and refresh the status.
